examples.text: — Moi, disait le jeune bataillonnaire, j’en ai dans la patte, un éclat de fusant. J’brancardais étant d’la discipline vu que j’suis en tôle pour quinze jours encore. J’ai rien senti.

examples.text: The jointed stretcher is used in place of the sectional bottom board, with two sideboards, one each side of stretcher. […] these seem to indicate a thwart, foot-timber (stretcher), thole-pin combination for rowing.

glosses: One of the rods in an umbrella, attached at one end to one of the ribs, and at the other to the tube sliding upon the handle.
